blocks.label: Short answer
blocks.copy: Use Apple Dictation for short everyday text because it is built into macOS. Use local Whisper-style dictation when you want to choose the recognition model, run an offline test, and keep dictation inside a privacy-first writing workflow.

blocks.text: Why Apple Dictation is still the default recommendation

content.s: Apple Dictation is already there. It starts from the microphone key, a keyboard shortcut, or the Edit menu, and it works in ordinary text fields. That matters. For a quick message, the best tool is usually the one you do not have to install.

blocks.text: Why local Whisper-style dictation is different

content.s: OpenAI describes Whisper as a general-purpose speech recognition model. In a local Mac app, the important part is not the name alone. The app should expose the model, keep cleanup local, avoid saving transcripts by default, and still work after you disable networking.

Gojo uses local dictation as part of a wider Mac workflow. If your real problem is that writing, clipboard recovery, file staging, window control, and media checks all interrupt each other, the notch workspace matters as much as the recognizer.
